provenance.what: Pass 1 of #397: the 17 finished title runs, reviewed by hand, frame by frame. No title_verdict.py verdict.json exists for them, so without this file the page counted them as untested.
provenance.label: hand-reviewed, pass 1
notes: reached: yes = a player-controlled scene confirmed from the frames (the table's `review` and `route` rows); late = gameplay only in the last frames, not measured; no = the run never left the menus.
Titles are named as on the handhelds (logs/titlepipe/batch-20260925.tsv, titles/already-on-handhelds.json); `as_reported` keeps pass 1's short name.
DOA Ultimate (DOA2U) is the Dead or Alive 1 Ultimate disc: [lane.xbox] correction on #397, 2026-09-26T21:14:04Z, from the soak's request.json.
No run reached the 600 s screening length and none ran the 20-minute soak, so every soak cell is 'not run'.
